Correct small-r asymptotics give p1(r)>2/pi^(3/2) near zero and decay at infinity, hence a distinct fixed-radius local maximum persists for all q sufficiently near one. Local C² convergence preserves inner peak; outer one stays bounded away from zero. The full volume density strictly decreases radially since every centered Gaussian component does.
